title: Add uploaded PNG assets to frontend/public so HDDHub images render

requirements.text:
Create the missing `frontend/public` directory (if it does not exist) and add the 5 user-uploaded PNG files into it using these exact canonical filenames so the app’s existing asset resolution (`ASSET_PATHS` / fallback chains) can load them:
- `frontend/public/bg.png`
- `frontend/public/vinyl.png`
- `frontend/public/bodyhdd.png`
- `frontend/public/disk.png`
- `frontend/public/arm.png`
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/` exists in the repository after the change.
The five canonical files `bg.png`, `vinyl.png`, `bodyhdd.png`, `disk.png`, `arm.png` exist directly under `frontend/public/` (not nested).
On a fresh build/preview, the background and HDD hub images load without 404s when viewing the deployed site.

requirements.text: Ensure the three selected HDDHub `` elements render the newly added canonical public assets (no code changes outside these selected elements). The selected elements are: - Element 1 XPath: `/html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[2]/div[2]/div[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[1]/img[1]` - Element 2 XPath: `/html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[2]/div[2]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/img[1]` - Element 3 XPath: `/html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[2]/div[2]/div[1]/div[1]/img[1]` These correspond to the HDD hub’s body, disk, and arm image layers, which must load `bodyhdd.png`, `disk.png`, and `arm.png` from the public root via the existing fallback chains.

quotes: The user has selected the following 3 elements from the page for context.

acceptanceCriteria: In the rendered UI, the HDD body, platter, and arm are visibly present (not missing/transparent placeholders) when the canonical PNGs are available.
Browser network tab shows successful loads (200) for `bodyhdd.png`, `disk.png`, and `arm.png` from the deployed base path (no root-absolute `/bodyhdd.png` style breakage on subpaths).
No other, non-selected elements are modified as part of this change.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/ui`.
Do not add any new backend functionality; this change is strictly static asset placement + ensuring the selected HDDHub image elements load those assets.
nonGoals: Any redesign of the HDDHub geometry, hover/click behavior, or animations.
Generating new images; use the user-uploaded PNGs as-is.
